question:

AQM, YOK, WMI, UKG, ?
solution:

**Given:** AQM, YOK, WMI, UKG, ?

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5e0ddaac8ea334221c9c10793b73fab7c2fdf216d0ed62a7a43e6fb458e11fb.png] 

Second letter:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50043ca2923f2cea9f616022fe7846835bb79370dc33a4f859b193bc2a4f2e44.png] 

Third letter:
